purpose: Role-based design relationships; adapt to the actual photos, never apply as fixed coordinates

compositions.relationship: title above lower hero; opposite two offset support frames connected by a shared edge
compositions.adaptation: keep people/landmark intact; move text rather than unsafe cropping

compositions.relationship: large environmental image opposite two separated daily details
compositions.adaptation: group by event; preserve sufficient scale for meaningful interactions

editorial.palette: pale field plus source colors; accent optional

compositions.relationship: large structural color plane opposite an offset pair; one emphasis phrase
compositions.adaptation: sample source colors; reduce saturation or add neutral pause when photography competes

compositions.relationship: optional oval with generous margins and short headline
compositions.adaptation: use rectangle/contain for hands, full bodies and architectural context

graphic-collage.palette: limited complementary fields and dark anchor, not compulsory yellow/pink

review: Clear visual center, mass and eye movement?
Shared edges or intentional spatial links?
